name: Aurora Model Tool MCP Query Interface
description: Read-only MCP tool subset for querying Aurora model homes without direct file access. Covers the minimum non-mutating capabilities in REQ-028 (for example: find cards by id/name/type/subtype; fetch normalized card representation; fetch inbound/outbound adjacency and bounded neighborhoods; query modelconfiguration; compute viable roots per the root safety rule; list possible next target types based on model configuration).
